user.title: Mood system
user.description: Select the existing mood helpers. They are only read, never changed. Rule observed: if Manual Mood equals the Auto option, Main Mood follows Auto Mood; otherwise Main Mood follows Manual Mood.

data_description.mismatch_grace_seconds: Your automations need a moment to copy the mood. A mismatch is reported only if it lasts longer than this.

categories.title: Light categories
categories.description: Map each category to a Home Assistant label. Lights are classified only by the labels applied to them (or their device). Categories can be added, renamed or removed later in the options.

data.create_missing_labels: Create labels for categories left empty

data_description.create_missing_labels: Only creates the labels. No label is applied to any light; you assign them yourself.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Select the areas to enable as rooms. Rooms can be enabled, disabled or reset later.

room_assign.title: Room: {room}

data_description.lights: Select either a group or its member lights, not both.
data_description.reference_occupancy_entity: Optional. Your existing room occupancy helper, observed for comparison in later phases.

profiles.title: Mood profiles
profiles.description: Prepare profile settings. Inheritance: Global → Room override → Individual light override. Profiles are stored and validated only; no light is controlled in this phase.
